description:
The full measurement of one portfolio in one call. In: holdings as weights or money amounts.
        Out: how many independent bets they make, each holding's share of the risk beside
        its share of the money, the companies owned through the funds, what past crises did
        and how long recovery took, and the numbered report. Typical questions: 'Analyze my
        portfolio: 60% VTI, 30% VXUS, 10% BND.'; 'What should I know about what I hold?';
        'Give me the full picture of this portfolio.'. Instead: for one narrow question use
        the narrower tool: portfolio_structure (spread of risk), look_through (companies),
        past_crises (crashes). For a quotable text with numbered figures, portfolio_report.
        For the shortest answer, plain_findings. It does not recommend, predict or calculate
        tax.

base.description: Currency code every figure is expressed in: USD, EUR, GBP, CAD… Default USD.
base.title: Base

holdings.description: What is held: {ticker: number}, 1 to 100 holdings. Weights in any scale (60/20/20 or 0.6/0.2/0.2) or money amounts in the base currency (60000/20000/20000): `units` says which; without it, holdings adding up to 1 or 100 are read as percentages, anything else as money, which makes the falls come out in money. Tickers as the exchange lists them (VOO, VWCE.DE, EQQQ.DE, XAW.TO; 'CASH.USD' for cash). Example: {"VTI": 60, "VXUS": 20, "BND": 20}.
holdings.title: Holdings

units.description: What the holdings' numbers are: 'money' (amounts in the base currency) or 'weights' (percentages or fractions). Omitted: holdings adding up to 1 or 100 are read as percentages, anything else as money, and the answer says so.
units.title: Units

name: measure_portfolio

lookthrough.description: What the portfolio owns through its funds.

covered_fraction.description: Share of the money whose underlying holdings are visible, 0 to 1.

opaque.description: Holdings with no breakdown to look through.

refused.description: Funds whose breakdown the data vendor refused.

top_symbol_weight.description: Its share of the whole portfolio.

report.description: The numbered report: every figure beside its method.

facts.description: One entry per figure: id, label, value, method, window, limit.

markdown.description: The report as markdown, figures numbered F1, F2…

receipt.description: A short plain-text receipt of the same figures.

stress.description: What past crises did to this mix, replayed on its holdings.
